name: Dark Magician raises critical damage 50% and spell power by 30% of Intellect (#696)
contract: Dark Magician 563123 reads 'Increases your critical damage dealt by 50% and your spell power by 30% of your Intellect.' In the installed Spell.dbc it is passive, family 31, with two Apply Aura (6) effects and no class mask (both apply unconditionally by school). Effect 0 is SPELL_AURA_MOD_CRIT_DAMAGE_BONUS (163), MiscValue 126 = every magic school bit (Holy..Arcane, bits 1-6, no Physical), BasePoints 49 / DieSides 1 = +50%. Effect 1 is SPELL_AURA_MOD_SPELL_DAMAGE_OF_STAT_PERCENT (174), MiscValue 127 (all schools), MiscValueB 3 = Intellect, BasePoints 29 / DieSides 1 = +30%. Unit::SpellBaseDamageBonusDone (Unit.cpp:9560-9592) adds int32(CalculatePct(Intellect, amount)) per matching MOD_SPELL_DAMAGE_OF_STAT_PERCENT aura (line 9590), recomputed from the player's CURRENT total Intellect every time the metric is queried -- it is not an incremental delta tied to whichever stat change triggered the read. The fixture must therefore measure the marginal effect against a baseline taken with the passive already learned but before the Intellect buff, not against a baseline from before either existed: base Intellect 99 with the passive gives int32(99*30/100)=29 spell power; +100 Intellect from Arcane Intellect 36880 raises total Intellect to 199, giving int32(199*30/100)=59; the marginal rise is exactly 59-29=30, matching the tooltip. (The first native run, which diffed against a pre-passive/pre-buff baseline of 0, read 59 -- 30% of the TOTAL 199 Intellect, not of the buff's own 100 -- confirming this fixture-ordering bug.) Unit::SpellCriticalDamageBonus (Unit.cpp:9926-9965) starts a magic spell's crit_bonus at 1.5x the base (1000 -> 1500), folds GetTotalAuraModifierByMiscMask(163, schoolMask) into crit_mod (line 9945), then AddPct's crit_bonus by crit_mod (line 9954) before subtracting and re-adding the base (lines 9956/9962). For Eldritch Shock 808043 (SchoolMask 32 = Shadow, inside the 126 mask), without the talent crit_mod is 0 so AddPct is skipped and the total stays 1500; with Dark Magician's crit_mod=50, 1500 is AddPct'd by 50% to 2250, so the total rises to 2250 -- a delta of exactly 750, unaffected by the Intellect buff's presence or absence.

steps.label: SETUP: Eldritch Shock's real crit total (1000 base) is 1500 without the talent
Spell power is unaffected by Intellect alone
Remove the Intellect buff before learning the passive, to isolate its marginal contribution
Shadow spell power with the passive on base (unbuffed) Intellect
Shadow spell power rises by exactly 30% of the buff's Intellect (30)
Eldritch Shock's crit total rises by exactly 750 (1500 -> 2250, AddPct'd by 50%)
